source_read.coverage: Full rigidity.tex read. No full source101 proof, primary-body or contribution review claimed.

quantitative_warning: Source exact rigidity extracts Taylor coefficients at origin. Small Gaussian L2 error does not uniformly control point jets as dimension grows. Distributional Hermite tests need a separate coercivity identity to isolate nonlinear q(A) coefficients.

normalization_lemma.statement: For any coupled centered isotropic R^m random vectors X,Z and positive-definite symmetric P, E|X-Z|^2 <= 4 E|PX-Z|^2.
normalization_lemma.proof: Diagonalize P orthogonally and rotate both random vectors. Each coordinate Xi,Zi has Hilbert L2 norm1. For eigenvalue pi>0, reverse triangle yields |1-pi| <= ||pi Xi-Zi||2. Triangle then gives ||Xi-Zi||2 <= |1-pi|+||pi Xi-Zi||2 <=2||pi Xi-Zi||2. Square and sum.
normalization_lemma.application: Once centered normalized transport F=PX is coupled close to a rotated centered product exponential Z, original isotropic X is close with this absolute factor. No bound on P inverse and no dimension factor needed.
normalization_lemma.contribution: Elementary support lemma only; does not supply quantitative compatibility or full entropy stability.
